On-Street
Operations
Parking Enforcement Officer
Parking Enforcement Supervisor
This team is the division’s largest, with 59
members who enforce all parking
regulations, issue parking citations,
monitor safety on the street, perform
traffic control duties, and provide
support to the Sacramento Police
Department and City Code
Enforcement, when needed.
Parking Enforcement Officers are initially
hired as part-time, with 20 guarante ed
hours. There is an option each week to
work an additional 20 hours per week.
Full-time (40 hours/week) status is
offered when those positions become
available.

All employees in “operations” classifications are
required to wear work uniforms for their safety
and visibility to the public while working on City
equipment or structures in the field. Uniforms are
provided and professionally cleaned on a weekly
basis by the Parking Services Division.
